entry.title: Oregon Sets 2027 Rent Increase Limit at 10%
entry.summary: Oregon’s rent increase limit will rise to 10% in 2027 for most covered rentals, including those in Douglas County. A separate 6% limit applies to spaces in larger manufactured home parks and marinas. Here’s what renters should know.

entry.title: I-5 Travelers Could Face 20-Minute Delays Near Glendale This Week
entry.summary: Drivers traveling I-5 between Glendale and Hugo could face delays of up to 20 minutes Tuesday through Thursday as crews stripe the highway and repair power lines.

entry.title: Hogan Road Fire Near Oakland Burns 7 Acres; DFPA Reminds Public That Fire Restrictions Remain in Effect

entry.title: Historic Rail Car Reunited With Dillard Depot After 16-Year Restoration

entry.title: Umpqua National Forest Announces Tentative Fall Campground Closure Schedule
entry.summary: Umpqua National Forest has released its tentative fall campground closure schedule. Some campgrounds are already closed, while others will remain open year-round with winter stays available on a first-come, first-served basis.

entry.title: Roseburg Council to Consider $289,020 Stewart Park Master Plan Contract
entry.summary: Roseburg City Council will consider a $289,020 contract to update the Stewart Park Master Plan, including Gaddis Park and the Umpqua Greenway. The planning work could be finished in fall 2027.

entry.title: Diamond Lake Boulevard Improvement Plan Heads to Roseburg Council Work Study
entry.summary: Roseburg councilors will review a draft Diamond Lake Boulevard and OR 138E corridor plan Monday. It identifies 51 potential transportation projects estimated at $90 million; no adoption vote is scheduled.

entry.title: Roseburg Council to Decide Whether to Keep Exploring Downtown Parking Lots for Urban Campground
entry.summary: Roseburg councilors will decide whether to stop, continue, or advance study of the Phillips and Shalimar parking lots as possible urban campground sites. No campground approval is on Monday’s agenda.

entry.title: Blocktober Fest returns for fifth year of fall festivities in Roseburg.
